item: GET /api/database/backup on a non-loopback name needs the header X-OO-Download: 1 when the request names no page it comes from (A-008, R445)
key_paths: src/api/database.py; tests/test_backup_download_route.py; tests/test_settings_api.py; tests/test_get_routes_side_effects.py; docs/SECURITY.md; docs/USER_MANUAL.md; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
summary: For a Host that is not loopback (a name the operator listed in OO_ALLOWED_HOSTS), GET /api/database/backup is refused with a 403 that names the header when the request carries none of Sec-Fetch-Site, Origin or Referer, unless it sends X-OO-Download: 1 (exactly the value 1). Before, such a request was served, so an img tag with referrerpolicy no-referrer on another site's page, which carries none of the three, could make the machine write a database snapshot; a script or curl adds the header, a cross-site page cannot add a custom header to a simple request. The header never rescues a request that said it was foreign: a cross-site Origin, Referer or Sec-Fetch-Site still refuses. Loopback names are unchanged. The refusal comes before the disk is touched and before the one-at-a-time slot is claimed. No page in src/static calls the route, so no UI or locale change. Measured: 107 route tests green, a test pins that no page under src/static names the route (so the app's own pages are never refused for lacking the header), 7 mutants each turn a named test red. Not measured: a real browser (the no-header claim for an img at a plain-HTTP operator name is from the Fetch spec, not run).
